title: Memory
description: One durable fact in memories/. Frontmatter fields plus a distilled body. Written only by the Manager.

type.description: feedback: a human correction. ruling: a PM/Architect decision binding beyond one task. failure: a stuck post-mortem.

scope.description: 'all', a role name (manager | product-manager | architect | dev-engineer | qe-engineer | code-reviewer), or a workspace repo id / path. Routes the entry at build time: 'all' and repo scopes are global (every agent's index); a role scope reaches only that role's agents plus the Manager. Narrow scope keeps the index cheap for agents it does not concern — a rule scoped wider than who can violate it costs everyone else context and invites misapplication.

rule.description: The distilled instruction, actionable by an agent who never saw the original exchange. Not a transcript.

why.description: The reason. A rule without its reason gets misapplied at the edges.

pinned.description: Survives compaction untouched: never merged, reworded, or pruned; the entry and its index line pass through every round verbatim. For rules whose exact wording matters or that must never lose prominence. Set by the Manager, sparingly — a pin is a permanent context cost.

compacted_from.description: Ids merged into this entry during compaction; each source is marked superseded-by this id. The merged rule must carry every source instruction at full strength.

origin_task.description: Task id this arose from, if any.

applications.description: Reserved for the feedback loop: times an agent cited this entry. Unused today; enables pruning rules that never fire.
